purpose: Installer-lane first-time approved Master Plant Pool taxa, source-neutral and 1-photo provisional threshold. Physical photo rights, exact iNaturalist species, SHA, morphology and canonical readback required; no county-native audit.

selected.look_here_first: Examine alternate pinnate leaves with hairy leaflets, then the pea-shaped pink flowers in loose racemes and developing legume pods; compare leaflet hairiness and flower structure.
Look for sprawling reddish stems with dense woolly gray leaves; inspect the minute greenish-yellow flowers tucked into leaf axils and branched hairs under magnification.
Examine alternate often irregularly toothed leaves and small axillary flowers; confirm the conspicuously inflated, ten-ribbed papery calyx surrounding each developing berry.
